scope: Coverage against the current atlas timeline, not every event or relationship in world history. A linked entry may have selected contacts or context relationships rather than direct political succession. Archaeological uncertainty is retained explicitly.

entries.title: Caral-Supe
entries.reason: Shown as an early Andean urban centre. The reviewed evidence establishes its early urban and ceremonial importance but does not justify a direct political succession arrow to the much later Wari, Tiwanaku or Inca states.
